prompts.settlement_a: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a premium 2D pixel-art medieval village management roguelite. Create exactly 9 independent building sprites, arranged in a STRICT evenly spaced 3 columns by 3 rows grid on a square 1536x1536 transparent canvas. Each cell is exactly 512x512. All objects fully inside their cell with 40px transparent margins. Identical front three-quarter RPG view looking slightly down, visible front and right wall, ground feet at 85% cell height. Architectural silhouette and tiny deliberate clusters at native 128x128 pixel scale enlarged 4x with crisp square hard edges. Restrained 24-colour palette: blue charcoal shadows, desaturated pine, warm ochre, russet clay roof, cream plaster, aged brown oak. Very high quality handcrafted 16-bit pixel-game sprite language, no smooth digital painting, no gradients, no antialiasing, no labels. Ground contact shadows and tiny irregular stone/grass footprint under each sprite, no huge bases. Row 1 left to right: humble thatched half-timber housing cluster; stone water well with wooden roof and bucket; warm tavern with red tiled roof, hanging unlettered mug sign and small barrel. Row2: small herbal clinic with sage roof and herb bundles (no modern cross); medieval stone chapel with bell tower; covered market stall cluster with blue cloth awnings and produce crates. Row3: wagon depot with stable, cart and stacked hay; compact lord's stone-and-timber administrative hall with blue pennant; old village relic sanctuary with three small coloured glass lamps and central stone altar. One isolated object per grid cell, all same camera and lighting from upper left. Keep separate sprites separate. Transparent background, no text, no UI, no people, no watermark.

prompts.manor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide pixel-art background for a Korean medieval lord management roguelite, 1536x1024 landscape. A beautifully crafted modest frontier lord's office, front three-quarter side view like a premium 16-bit RPG interior. Massive oak beams, stone fireplace glowing at far right, tall leaded window in upper centre showing a distant pine valley, shelves with scrolls and tiny jars at left edge, hanging blue-green banner, big sturdy wooden council table in lower middle, a small unlettered parchment and brass inkpot on its edge, wooden chair behind. Mood: practical lived-in administrative room, hopeful morninglight, not extravagant palace. Composition specifically for gameplay: upper central quarter is calm plain plaster wall; centre and lower thirds have broad quiet wood surfaces and shadow areas where readable interface panels can sit. Distinct coherent floor plane and warmly lit furniture, meticulous high quality native384x256 pixelart enlarged4x with nearest, consistent visible square pixels, tight32colour palette muted blue slate, pinegreen, warm oak, cream, amber highlights. No painterly/soft rendering, no photographic texture, no blur, no gradients, no modern objects. No text of anykind, no UI/buttons, no people, no watermark.
